The largest country in the world is Russia.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a place for "stitch and bitch," but this week, the real drama wasn’t the gossip—it was the feline crime scene. Her cat, clearly bored with the usual yarn, decided to unravel an entire sweater worth of wool, leaving a trail of breadcrumbs so extensive that Hansel and Gretel would have been envious. The house looked like a woolly disaster zone, and Aunt May had to decide whether to knit a new sweater or just adopt the cat as her new, very destructive, club member.
